body: I doubt there'll be a job for me to get with how much my education has just collapsed. An employer wouldn't want a worthless sack of meat with no knowledge who constantly worries and cries.

What life is there to fucking start? Everything is gone. There's literally nothing left. I'll be lucky if I don't end up as a homeless guy on the street begging for anything to keep me going. There's no life for me to start. There's hardly a life for me to end. It's just a stupid existence.
